com.sun.corba.se.spi.orbutil.fsm

接口 Input

  • 所有已知实现类:
    InputImpl

    public interface Input
    This interface must be implemented by any class that is used as an input to a FSM. The FSM only needs the identity of this object, so all that is really needs is the default equals implementation. The toString() method should also be overridden to give a concise description or name of the input.

    Ken Cavanaugh
